function.description: Retrieves a summary of all Security Service Insertions (SSIs) sorted by fabricSiteName.
function.name: api_securityServiceInsertionSummary

fabricSiteName.description: Filter by fabric site name (supports partial search). For example, searching for "London" will match "London fabric site", etc.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

order.description: The sorting order for the response can be specified as either ascending (asc) or descending (desc). If no value is specified, the default order is ascending (asc).

response.description: List of summaries of Security Service Insertion.

borderNodesCount.description: Count of Border nodes involved in the service insertion.

controlPlaneNodesCount.description: Count of Control plane nodes involved in the service

edgeNodesCount.description: Count of Edge nodes involved in the service insertion.

fabricSiteName.description: The name of the SDA fabric site.

id.description: The unique identifier of the Security Service Insertion (SSI).

provisionStatus.description: The readiness status of the fabric site.

virtualNetworksAssociatedCount.description: Count of virtual networks associated with this security service insertion.
